findings.summary: `ganymede mcp call` now sends `_meta["ganymede/dir"]` from its own cwd, but the journal plugin's hook (hooks/journal.mjs) runs it with cwd = input.cwd and passes a `state.path` taken from the agent's own tool args. After the agent cd's into a subfolder in Bash, paths like `journal/a.ipynb` resolve to `sub/journal/a.ipynb`. Before the change paths were root-relative and cwd only chose the server. A consumer of the changed behaviour was not updated.

notes: The posted pass was on af8c722; the finding was verified on the merged head 4d043ba.
